name: ANCContactStart
title: Antenatal care: start of contact (WHO SMART, pilot)
description: At the start of an antenatal care contact, checks the danger signs (proceed with the contact, or refer) and whether HIV and syphilis tests are due. Source: WHO antenatal care recommendations (2016), Digital Adaptation Kit (2021), implemented with 3 unmodified WHO SMART ANC decision tables (CQL): ANC.DT.01 (WHO workflow step ANC.B5 Quick check), ANC.DT.08 and ANC.DT.11 (ANC.B9 Laboratory tests).
usage: Pilot. Evaluates the start of one ANC contact (encounter-start): the encounter is context.encounterId. Needs the Observations of that encounter, coded with the WHO ANC data dictionary codes or, through a curated binding, SNOMED CT; the ANC contact number is an Encounter extension. WHO SMART ANC IG 0.3.0 (continuous integration build, not a published release). The data come from the IG's Questionnaires ANC.A Registration (contact number), ANC.B5 Quick check (danger signs), ANC.B6 Profile (gestational age) and ANC.B9 Lab tests (HIV and syphilis status).
